affected_system: housing-stability, eviction prevention, shelter diversion, and support coordination
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of housing-stability prevention assistance
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for housing-stability prevention assistance
pair rights-preserving eligibility and minimum-service allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Court, assistance, shelter, outreach, housing, and service records use privacy-preserving linkage.
Risk models support outreach only and never determine legal rights or automatic denial.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for housing-stability prevention assistance.

constraints.description: The homelessness prevention and housing stability allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: homelessness response director and housing-stability administrator
decision_question: How should limited flexible funds, legal capacity, shelter diversion, and case navigation be assigned?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The homelessness prevention and housing stability allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for housing-stability prevention assistance passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible urgent households without assigned assistance

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting housing-stability prevention assistance, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible urgent households without assigned assistance
distributional gap in eligible urgent households without assigned assistance
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report allocated funds or case capacity as received assistance or stable housing.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for housing-stability prevention assistance passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate rental, legal, diversion, and navigation assistance
transportability_risks: Eviction law, rents, benefits, shelter systems, informal displacement, and data linkage differ.
Administrative records omit people who do not seek or cannot access services.
